player_prompt.intro:
Ningol Tower of Hanoi {num_disks} disks khara khelre.
A tower gi C tower ta disks khara taragani.
Disk amatta taraba, source tower ama target tower (e.g., '[A C]') taragani.
Note that tower top gi disk amatta taragani, ama nongma disk nongchup gi khara taragadabani.
Khut ahanba, submit one move taragani.
